items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 13:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Ben Oni (son of my strength), the power of the Nukva? The spirit that her husband casts into her is called Benjamin, which is a male power, because it comes from the AB of the Mazal, which is the aspect of male MAN. And it is what corrects the vessel of the Yesod of the Nukva, and from this aspect the vessel of the Yesod of the Nukva is called by the name “Ben Oni”, for Oni means strength, indicating that in this is all the power of the Nukva, in that she is able to raise MAN for the birth of souls, because she received in her Yesod this spirit that her husband cast into her in the first union, which is the aforementioned Benjamin. (Item 105).
